newsitem.title: UK: Copper stays firmer in LME evening, price settles.
newsitem.headline: Copper stays firmer in LME evening, price settles.

text.p: Copper prices remained firmer during Tuesday evening inter-office London Metal Exchange (LME) trading, building on the earlier clearance of psychological resistance at $1,900, traders said.
The market received a boost today from the larger-than-expected fall in warehouse stocks of 8,825 tonnes, although once short-covering had run its course prices eased back from peaks of $1,927.
At 1819 gmt three months was indicated at $1,919/24 a tonne, against Monday's $1,883 close.
Aluminium similarly consolidated this evening, and was quoted at $1,401/403 a tonne, up from an overnight $1,392.
